authority: Original captured declaration AST; no captured JavaScript evaluated
summary: One page of the holder-rewards book per request: fees accrued to each vault, payouts, and book totals

cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor from a previous page (next); exclusive with the page parameters (sort, direction, quote, payingOnly, page, limit)

sort.description: Book-wide sort; default accrued. distributed orders by payouts.paidToHoldersUsd at the current quote mark; accruedNow and distributed omit coins whose quote has no mark or decimals (totals.unpricedCoinCount)

payingOnly.description: Only coins with a holder payout

generatedAt.description: ISO instant the book's open-day fold last ran (every 60 s)

holderRewardsPda.description: Holder-rewards PDA ["holder-rewards", mint] under the pump program

athMarketCapUsd.description: ATH market cap in USD, as the coin registry stores it (no conversion); null when unknown

quote.description: Whole quote units as a decimal string

paidToHolders.description: Atomic units of quoteMintAddress; null when the index has no holder payout for the coin

paidToHoldersUsd.description: paidToHoldersQuote times quotes[quoteMintAddress].usdPrice as a decimal string; null when either is unknown

coins.description: Ordered by the sort in page mode; cursor mode orders by accrued.usdAtTrade, then usdNow, descending, then mint

next.description: Opaque cursor into the book's default order, only in cursor mode (no page/limit/sort); null on the last page and in page mode. Pages hold up to 2,000 coins ordered by accrued.usdAtTrade descending; a coin can move between pages as the book folds every 60 s; totals and quotes describe the whole book, not the page.

imageUri.description: Quote registry logo URL; null when the registry row has none

quotes.description: Every quote mint the coins accrued or paid in, and every byQuote mint; symbol, name and imageUri from the quote registry when it lists the mint

walletsRewarded.description: Distinct wallets paid, summed per coin

walletsRewardedDistinct.description: Distinct wallets paid at least once across the book; a wallet paid by two coins counts once

payoutCount.description: Sum of payouts.payoutCount over the book

matchingCount.description: Coins matching the request's filter, the paging denominator; equals totals.coinCount with no filter

offset.description: Offset of coins[0] in the sorted, filtered set

accrued.description: Atomic units of quoteMintAddress (decimals in quotes)

paid.description: Atomic units of quoteMintAddress (decimals in quotes)

byQuote.description: Per-quote facets over the whole book, unfiltered

x-holder-rewards-response.description: 503 with degraded_lanes [trade_api.get_fees] when the TradeApi lane is down or unconfigured. No Cache-Control of its own (a JWT caller gets no-store): fees change per block

reachability.disposition: Only the declaration names this operation. Its caller, service origin and authorization are not observed

siblingTransport.disposition: Context only: the sibling fee reads use 759257.j at https://frontend-api-v3.pump.fun; this does not bind holder-rewards to that origin
